description: Extreme vehicular black smoke and toxic smog choking commuters on Outer Ring Road near Anand Vihar ISBT. Heavy commercial diesel trucks without PUC certificates are idling constantly.
Thick pungent chemical smoke drifting into residential colonies from unregulated small foundry furnaces in Sanand Industrial Area late at night.
Dark foamy chemical effluent discharging directly into the Cooum River near Maduravoyal bridge. Water has turned pitch black with dead fish floating along the riverbanks.
Deafening commercial sound systems and outdoor horn-type loudspeakers operating after 11:30 PM near residential apartment blocks in Koramangala 4th Block, exceeding 85 decibels.
Repeated illegal dumping of municipal solid waste and building debris by unregistered tipper trucks along the dry lake bed margin near Singasandra lake road.
Enormous piles of single-use plastic covers, polythene carry bags, and non-woven polypropylene sacks clogging storm water drains in Dadar market area.
Untreated domestic blackwater sewage overflowing from ruptured underground trunk pipeline into open storm gutters in Laxmi Nagar, creating unbearable stench and breeding flies.
Chemical dye and textile processing factories in Pali Industrial Area discharging acidic red-colored effluents without treating through Common Effluent Treatment Plant (CETP).
Massive white toxic foam billowing from Bellandur Lake outlet into the storm water weir near Yemlur, drifting across the roadway onto vehicles and pedestrians.
Borewell water in communities adjacent to the Ghazipur landfill has turned yellowish-brown with high total dissolved solids (TDS over 2400 ppm) due to untreated leachate percolation.
Illegal cutting of over 40 mature Neem and Banyan trees along rural canal bank without forest department permission or transit permits by unauthorized private contractors.
Dumping of spent acidic pickling liquor and electroplating sludge directly onto agricultural soil surrounding manufacturing units, leading to complete soil salinization and crop failure.
Widespread open field burning of paddy crop residue (parali) across agricultural farms near Sunam, spreading dense acrid smoke over residential villages and state highway.
category: Agricultural Burning and Crop Residue Burning

description: Uncovered high-rise commercial construction site operating without green dust barrier netting or water sprinkling systems. Massive clouds of fine silica cement dust enveloping neighborhood.
Uncollected community garbage bins overflowing for over 10 days in T. Nagar market lane, with stray cattle scattering waste and decaying biological matter rotting in rainwater.
Discarded chemical drums containing flammable solvent residues and toxic paint sludge dumped haphazardly beside rural road culvert near Vapi industrial boundary.
Tar balls, engine bilge oil discharge, and discarded nylon monofilament fishing gear washing ashore in large quantities along Rushikonda Beach, posing danger to marine organisms.
Encroachment and dumping of construction rubble into the eco-sensitive wetland buffer corridor of Deepor Beel sanctuary, disrupting nesting birds and endemic migratory wildfowl.
category: Environmental Damage to Wildlife and Biodiversity

description: Unchecked quarry blasting operations causing structural vibrations in hillside settlement and triggering small land slips on slope above Rishikesh-Badrinath highway.
Untreated chrome and tannery wastewater bypassing solar evaporation pans in Jajmau industrial belt and entering holy Ganga river directly.
Fly ash slurry overflowing from breached ash dyke of thermal power plant into Rihand reservoir and adjacent agricultural lands in Singrauli.
Extensive burning of garbage and plastic scrap piles at Deonar dumping ground sending choking smog and carcinogens into Chembur and Govandi residents homes.
Night-time discharge of untreated acidic wastewater into Najafgarh Drain near Keshopur, producing suffocating hydrogen sulfide smells across residential colonies in Janakpuri.
Heavy construction transit trucks carrying uncovered sand and gravel along Noida Expressway spreading thick dust clouds and reducing visibility for school vans.
